notes.title: Demo Update v.0.1.2
notes.content:
[p]Long time no see!

It has been a little while since the last update, many apologies! Unfortunately, there had been delays with some features in this update and on top of that, there was Gamescom the last week here in our hometown of Cologne. So a bit of time and effort went into prepping for the convention. But good news is there is finally a new update with some improvements and new features. 

First off, we had the request to add in a save system. With the addition of the progression tree, the demo has become quite a bit longer than we initially had planned. So, a way to save your progress was long overdue! It has not been playtested to the fullest extent yet, so if you do encounter any problems with it, please report them over on the discord. Many thanks!!

Almost more important than adding a way to save was actually fixing the customer spawn rates. Something was pretty broken here, without going into too much detail: We should have our customers back, ideally a lot of them! 

This brings us to one more feature: the trash can. To help out with the trash these new customers will most definitely leave behind, we added a way to keep the outside of the kiosk clean. The trash can must be unlocked first and can then be bought in the shop. It forced customers to throw away any trash they have instead of throwing it on the ground.

Now at last but definitely not least we have a great new addition to our Kiosk staff: the Chefin. The Chef's wife is now a playable character, besides the OG Chef. Until they get to manage and fight alongside, you have to decide which character you want to play when starting a new singleplayer game (only visual/cosmetic currently).

This wraps up most changes from this update. Check out all the changes below!

Let us know what you think about these new features. Many thanks and until next time (hopefully not in a month)!

[i][b]Neptun Interactive

notes.title: DEMO Release
notes.content:
[h1]A milestone achieved[/h1][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//44788849/c84909926e006feb837db95ab99830e900104dbe.png"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Public demo is out![/b][/p][p]After 6 months of close internal development, we are proud to announce the release of our first public demo - we sincerely hope you enjoy it! Expect never-before-seen gameplay features like a full [i]CooP-Mode[/i], wares and price [i]progression[/i], and a full-fledged [i]skill tree[/i] for the Chef and his lovely wife! We also welcome you to join our new, dedicated Discord server to share feedback and questions or to mingle and philosophize about gaming in general: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/Wq6jvjS34Y"]https://discord.gg/Wq6jvjS34Y[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//44788849/a71aec91e38be47b81593e36d6d0557063df4b45.png"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]The last six months were stressful, and we want to apologize for being quiet on our socials and in here. We promise to give our best to stay more public from this day onwards, so feel free to also check "Neptun Interactive" on Instagram and TikTok. While the important stuff will be posted here and on Discord, some behind-the-scenes tomfoolery awaits you there, when you check in from time to time.[/p][p][/p][p][b]But enough talking[/b] - play and enjoy the demo and let us know how you feel about it at Discord: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/Wq6jvjS34Y"]https://discord.gg/Wq6jvjS34Y[/url][/p][p] See you soon, we look forward to hearing about your endeavours to become a kiosk-shop imperator! Neptun out - until next time![/p]

notes.title: MERRY CHRISTMAS + 2024 RECAP
notes.content:
[h1]We wish you all the best![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788849/77ce90b63dfa45f19cd05de41e22208726e96cbe.png[/img]

[b]Hello and a merry Christmas to you all![/b]

As the snow blankets Germany, lights glow warmly, the fruits of a productive year are brought home from the kiosk! And a bountiful year it was – after nearly 6 months of traveling to attend events, meetings and public exhibitions, we gathered enough feedback to know where our journey will lead us next. The chef made many friends (and dabbled with some foes) and gained the knowledge to upgrade his shop to never expected standards.


And there are also some special gifts in the bag: We are happy to announce that “Kiosk Simulator” is  now officially supported by the German “Press Start: Gründungsstipendium Games” stipend, our deepest gratitude goes towards this one of a kind program*! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788849/b266ab9810c25bdfcf1745b9340642d03619e943.jpg[/img]

As an independent studio without external funding, this opportunity enables us to dedicate our full attention to the development of our game. It allows us to accelerate our progress and ensure we deliver the highest-quality user experience possible for you – great things lie ahead!

The entire team at Neptun Interactive thanks for your support. Stay tuned for updates, and in the meantime, we wish you a wonderful end-of-year celebration. And if you’re stocking up at your local shop, don’t forget to think of the Chef!

[i]*The Games Start-Up Grant is managed by “game – Verband der Deutschen Games-Branche” in collaboration with the “Stiftung Digitale Spielekultur”. It is funded by the Federal Government Commissioner for Culture and Media. [/i]

notes.title: Kiosk Simulator @ Gamescom | Recap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788849/0920cde575f203cf11ac5ffcfdca5e4ef2284bf0.png[/img]

Tach!

We've successfully made it past the gamescom madness!

We had the pleasure of showcasing our newest build of Kiosk Simulator at the Games From NRW stand of the Indie Arena. It was a tough few days, but it was certainly worth it. Getting to meet and talk to so many players was a truly amazing experience. Thanks to everyone that took the time to come by our booth!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788849/cc2bf5a72d91468e9eaf84f778c14a85d436c23c.png[/img]

But lets start at the beginning. The gamescom week kicked off with a real banger for us. We had the honor of being part of the German Indie Showcase organized by Gronkh, a german Youtube legend. You can see their reaction to our newest trailer right [url=https://gronkh.tv/streams/907?at=1h34m19s]here[/url]. It has helped us out tremendously and absolutely perfected our kick off to the gamescom. We hope many of those who saw our trailer at the showcase have found their way over to our community here. Welcome!

Throughout the gamescom we had the pleasure of talking to a few different news outlets. Some traditional media, like newspaper journalists, as well as digital ones like YouTube or TikTok channels. Two newspapers wrote articles about Kiosk Simulator, the team and our inspiration for making this game. If you are interested in reading up on them, please do so [url=https://rp-online.de/digitales/games/gamescom/gamescom-2024-kiosk-simulator-aus-koeln-basiert-auf-wahrer-begebenheit_aid-118117437]here[/url] and [url=https://www.rnd.de/wirtschaft/unser-kiosk-verdient-sein-eigenes-spiel-also-haben-wir-eins-gemacht-2WK4F2ZPWFHHBFLK3KCN7Y3RHI.html]here[/url] (both german only).

We got to talk to the great folks over at GartenHaus Games about Kiosk Simulator. They compiled a great video about Indie Games at gamescom. We made it in there so check it out [url=https://youtu.be/5qWVMl5laBo?si=bZCXv4SKpKPUXG7D&t=32]here[/url]!

We had the chance to talk to great people and build new contacts over the course of the gamescom week. Kiosk Simulator and our team have benefited greatly from this experience. So, many thanks to all of you for the support!! Also, thanks a lot to the Film- und Medienstiftung NRW for sponsoring our booth at this year's gamescom.

It was a true pleasure!

Until then!
[i]Neptun Interactive[/i]

notes.title: Kiosk Simulator @ Indie Game Fest | Recap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788849/258931c4b2342b92fe19805ab6d57b8cb6f0deec.jpg[/img]

We went to Indie Game Fest (31st May - 1st June) in our hometown Cologne and got to present our early prototype of [b]Kiosk Simulator[/b]! 
We are very thankful, that we had the opportunity to showcase the game at our own booth, which was sponsored by KölnBusiness.

The feedback from many players was quite positive and most importantly people had a lot of fun talking about their experience and ideas about the game. We have been able to connect to a lot of great people and also use the opportunity to pitch the game to a live audience at the venue.

We met the awesome folks behind [b]LP4Charity[/b], a non-profit organization that was running a livestream at the Indie Game Fest to collect donations for two amazing charity projects.
You can see our interview with them here: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2160771155?t=3h1m44s]Twitch VOD[/url] (German)

Unfortunately we forgot to announce our participation at the Indie Game Fest before the actual event, so for future events we will make sure to give everyone a heads up!

Thank you to everyone that took the time to check out our game. Until next time!
[i]Neptun Interactive[/i]
